answer: Each epoch, agents grade services via a panel chosen by verifiable-random lottery from the reputational pool, reseeded every epoch. Fixed juries never form, so colluding with graders is a lottery ticket: an attacker must bribe an unpredictable random panel before identities are revealed, paying costs scaling with pool size for at most one epoch of influence before the vine reshuffles. Honest agents need only exist as violet-attested unique voters; sybil clones buy zero expected votes, like juniper roots anchoring shifting soil.
